bullets: • Validate DOM elements exist before population; reference Cycle Time card pattern.
• Sanitize all dynamic content with escHtml before inserting into DOM.
• Build changelog entries simultaneously with feature implementation, not after.
• Scope CSS rules to feature boundaries; verify no selector leakage.
• Map acceptance criteria to test cases before writing patch code.
• Extend previous patch selectors for dependent features; avoid duplication.
• Document sorting logic and data transforms inline for sanitization clarity.
• Run structure, versioning, metadata, styling validation together before submission.
